task.title: Add a research question
task.shortdesc: Write down a question before you answer it, link it to the people it is about, and say whether it is still open.

context.p: A good researcher writes the question down first. A question can stay open. When you look for something and do not find it, write down where you looked. Not finding a record tells you about the search. It does not tell you about the person.

stepresult.p: A new tree says No research questions or notes yet.

step.cmd: Choose , then under Add to the workspace, then .
Type the question or the note in .

info.p: Say what you looked at and what you found. If you found nothing, say where you looked and under what name.

step.cmd: Choose , then Open, In progress or Resolved.

info.p: Type a name, choose the person from the list, then choose .

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom and choose .

stepresult.p: The question shows in the list. A line under it says whether it is open, and how many records link to it.

result.p: When you reach a conclusion, edit the note. Write the evidence, your reasoning and how sure you are, so that a stranger could follow it. Never choose between two records without saying why.
